'''Fred's farm''', also known as the '''Lumbridge farm''', is a large farm in Lumbridge found north of the [[Lumbridge Castle]]. The farm is owned by [[Fred the Farmer]], and is worked by Fred and several [[farmers]].

==Quests==
* Players commence [[Sheep Shearer]] by speaking to Fred the Farmer, who will request the player to shear his sheep.
* During [[Cold War]], players will talk to the [[Sheep (penguins)]].
